protocol: The full-frame reference and selected detector use the same video and sample timestamps. The selected detector feeds three-observation tracking, crosshair geometry and acquisition events. Anchors and eligible frames differ, so aim metrics are descriptive. The full-frame reference uses confidence 0.12 and size 1280. The selected iteration uses its recorded input size and post-rescoring threshold.
interpretation: Counts and proxy distributions only. No precision, recall, mAP, hit accuracy or human reaction-time claim without annotated ground truth.
